title: Physical Health & Vitality Calculator
subtitle: Body metrics, a short lifestyle check, and everyday tips — in plain language.
seoDescription: Free physical vitality calculator: height, weight, activity, sleep, and nutrition plus a short quiz. BMI, energy estimates, and practical tips — in your browser.
heroDescription: A simple snapshot of energy, recovery, and activity — with clear numbers and small tips you can use today.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: You enter height, weight, age, sex, activity, sleep, and nutrition — and get metrics like BMI and energy estimates.
A short quiz covers daytime energy, water, strength, and recovery.
The report shows a vitality score, a clear breakdown, and small tips.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill in your details, answer the short quiz, and view the report.
Save to history (expand on the home grid) or download a result card.
Use the result as a compass — not a medical diagnosis.

sections.heading: Important to know
paragraphs: This tool is for inspiration and enrichment only and does not replace certified medical advice.
The metrics are common everyday estimates — not a clinical diagnosis.

benefits.title: Simple inputs
benefits.description: Height, weight, and activity — without unnecessary complexity.

benefits.title: Short quiz
benefits.description: About 10 questions on energy, water, and recovery.

benefits.title: Practical tips
benefits.description: Small steps you can try today.

faq.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
faq.answer: No. It's everyday common-sense support — not a substitute for professional care.

faq.question: What does BMI mean here?
faq.answer: It's a common helper number. It doesn't tell your whole health story.

faq.question: Is data stored on a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in the browser.
